target.title: fix(browser): recover answers after recoverable CDP disconnect
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes recoverable CDP client disconnects that previously stranded completed browser answers as permanently `running`.

When the target-level DevTools WebSocket drops mid-run, Oracle used to treat every disconnect as "Chrome window closed," keep the session running, and skip the auto-reattach path that already exists for `assistant-timeout`. In #326 the browser and page target were still alive, ChatGPT finished the answer, and Oracle never harvested it.

## Approach

1. Probe DevTools liveness (`/json/version` + optional target list) after a CDP client disconnect.
2. If Chrome/target is still reachable, surface `recoverableDisconnect` instead of a closed-window message.
3. On `connection-lost` with recoverable runtime, attempt a one-shot `resumeBrowserSession` auto-reattach by default; keep the existing "session stays running + guidance" fallback when resume fails.
4. If `autoReattachIntervalMs` is configured, retain multi-attempt polling.

## Runtime proof (merge readiness)

Addressing ClawSweeper merge-readiness: prove both disconnect outcomes against **real Chrome CDP** (not mocks).

Script: `node scripts/cdp-disconnect-proof.mjs`

Redacted transcript (2026-07-17, local macOS Google Chrome headless):

```text
[…] launch: Chrome headless with remote debugging
[…] chrome-up: port=<port> pid=<pid>
[…] page-ready: title=oracle-cdp-proof
[…] target: id=<id>…
[…] case-1: CDP client disconnect; Chrome+target remain
[…] case-1-result: {"endpointReachable":true,"targetFound":true,"recoverable":true,"userMessage":"Chrome DevTools client disconnected before oracle finished; the browser target appears still alive."}
[…] case-1-pass: recoverableDisconnect path; sessionRunner would auto-reattach
[…] case-2: close target + kill Chrome
[…] case-2-result: {"endpointReachable":false,"targetFound":null,"recoverable":false,"userMessage":"Chrome window closed before oracle finished. Please keep it open until completion.","error":"fetch failed"}
[…] case-2-pass: closed-window message; no stale auto-reattach loop

PROOF_OK both disconnect outcomes demonstrated against real Chrome CDP
```

Harvest path after recoverable disconnect (sessionRunner) remains covered by unit tests that assert `resumeBrowserSession` success marks the session `completed` with recovered answer text (`tests/cli/sessionRunner.test.ts`: "auto-reattaches after connection loss and marks session completed").

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm exec vitest run tests/browser/cdpLiveness.test.ts tests/cli/sessionRunner.test.ts` (39 passed)
- [x] `pnpm run typecheck` / build
- [x] `node scripts/cdp-disconnect-proof.mjs` → `PROOF_OK` (real Chrome, both outcomes)

Fixes #326
